description: This file contains classes and methods for running and managing LTP (Linux Test Project) POSIX compliance runtime tests, including setup, teardown, and test execution logic.

classes.name: LtpPosixBase
classes.description: Base class for LTP POSIX runtime tests, providing setup and teardown methods.

classes.name: LtpPosixTest
classes.description: Derived class implementing specific POSIX group tests for LTP, including test execution and result parsing.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initial setup for the test class, calls ltp_startup.

methods.name: ltp_startup
methods.description: Prepares directories, initializes logs and results storage.

methods.name: ltp_finishup
methods.description: Finalizes logs, updates symlinks, and records sections.

methods.name: runltp
methods.description: Runs a specific POSIX group test, logs output, parses results, and records failures.

methods.name: test_posix_groups
methods.description: Test method that runs POSIX group tests, depends on SSH connection and LTP package.
